title: Perplexity Adds Live Web Search Capability to Decisions API
summary:
Perplexity has introduced a "web_grounding" mode for its Decisions API, allowing the pplx-decider-v1.2 model to retrieve real time information to inform its answers. The integration enables the API to run one Fast Search query per question or pull data from a specific URL, providing current factual context for batch-mode decision making that was previously limited to a model's training data.

The updated API costs $0.02 per 1 million input tokens, while each search request is priced at $0.001. The company stated the update allows for more accurate batch decisions by providing the model with access to the live web.
